numbering: Standard 700-verse canon; Chapter 13 has 34 verses and excludes Arjuna's alternate opening question.
sourceChapterWithLineNumbers:
1:   Krishna.
2:   Now will I open unto thee--whose heart
3:   Rejects not--that last lore, deepest-concealed,
4:   That farthest secret of My Heavens and Earths,
5:   Which but to know shall set thee free from ills,--
6:   A royal lore! a Kingly mystery!
7:   Yea! for the soul such light as purgeth it
8:   From every sin; a light of holiness
9:   With inmost splendour shining; plain to see;
10:   Easy to walk by, inexhaustible!
11: 
12:   They that receive not this, failing in faith
13:   To grasp the greater wisdom, reach not Me,
14:   Destroyer of thy foes! They sink anew
15:   Into the realm of Flesh, where all things change!
16: 
17:   By Me the whole vast Universe of things
18:   Is spread abroad;--by Me, the Unmanifest!
19:   In Me are all existences contained;
20:   Not I in them!
21: 
22:   Yet they are not contained,
23:   Those visible things! Receive and strive to embrace
24:   The mystery majestical! My Being--
25:   Creating all, sustaining all--still dwells
26:   Outside of all!
27: 
28:   See! as the shoreless airs
29:   Move in the measureless space, but are not space,
30:   [And space were space without the moving airs];
31:   So all things are in Me, but are not I.
32: 
33:   At closing of each Kalpa, Indian Prince!
34:   All things which be back to My Being come:
35:   At the beginning of each Kalpa, all
36:   Issue new-born from Me.
37: 
38:   By Energy
39:   And help of Prakriti my outer Self,
40:   Again, and yet again, I make go forth
41:   The realms of visible things--without their will--
42:   All of them--by the power of Prakriti.
43: 
44:   Yet these great makings, Prince! involve Me not
45:   Enchain Me not! I sit apart from them,
46:   Other, and Higher, and Free; nowise attached!
47: 
48:   Thus doth the stuff of worlds, moulded by Me,
49:   Bring forth all that which is, moving or still,
50:   Living or lifeless! Thus the worlds go on!
51: 
52:   The minds untaught mistake Me, veiled in form;--
53:   Naught see they of My secret Presence, nought
54:   Of My hid Nature, ruling all which lives.
55:   Vain hopes pursuing, vain deeds doing; fed
56:   On vainest knowledge, senselessly they seek
57:   An evil way, the way of brutes and fiends.
58:   But My Mahatmas, those of noble soul
59:   Who tread the path celestial, worship Me
60:   With hearts unwandering,--knowing Me the Source,
61:   Th' Eternal Source, of Life. Unendingly
62:   They glorify Me; seek Me; keep their vows
63:   Of reverence and love, with changeless faith
64:   Adoring Me. Yea, and those too adore,
65:   Who, offering sacrifice of wakened hearts,
66:   Have sense of one pervading Spirit's stress,
67:   One Force in every place, though manifold!
68:   I am the Sacrifice! I am the Prayer!
69:   I am the Funeral-Cake set for the dead!
70:   I am the healing herb! I am the ghee,
71:   The Mantra, and the flame, and that which burns!
72:   I am-of all this boundless Universe-
73:   The Father, Mother, Ancestor, and Guard!
74:   The end of Learning! That which purifies
75:   In lustral water! I am OM! I am
76:   Rig-Veda, Sama-Veda, Yajur-Ved;
77:   The Way, the Fosterer, the Lord, the Judge,
78:   The Witness; the Abode, the Refuge-House,
79:   The Friend, the Fountain and the Sea of Life
80:   Which sends, and swallows up; Treasure of Worlds
81:   And Treasure-Chamber! Seed and Seed-Sower,
82:   Whence endless harvests spring! Sun's heat is mine;
83:   Heaven's rain is mine to grant or to withhold;
84:   Death am I, and Immortal Life I am,
85:   Arjuna! SAT and ASAT, Visible Life,
86:   And Life Invisible!
87: 
88:   Yea! those who learn
89:     The threefold Veds, who drink the Soma-wine,
90:   Purge sins, pay sacrifice--from Me they earn
91:     Passage to Swarga; where the meats divine
92: 
93:   Of great gods feed them in high Indra's heaven.
94:     Yet they, when that prodigious joy is o'er,
95:   Paradise spent, and wage for merits given,
96:     Come to the world of death and change once more.
97: 
98:   They had their recompense! they stored their treasure,
99:     Following the threefold Scripture and its writ;
100:   Who seeketh such gaineth the fleeting pleasure
101:     Of joy which comes and goes! I grant them it!
102: 
103:   But to those blessed ones who worship Me,
104:   Turning not otherwhere, with minds set fast,
105:   I bring assurance of full bliss beyond.
106: 
107:   Nay, and of hearts which follow other gods
108:   In simple faith, their prayers arise to me,
109:   O Kunti's Son! though they pray wrongfully;
110:   For I am the Receiver and the Lord
111:   Of every sacrifice, which these know not
112:   Rightfully; so they fall to earth again!
113:   Who follow gods go to their gods; who vow
114:   Their souls to Pitris go to Pitris; minds
115:   To evil Bhuts given o'er sink to the Bhuts;
116:   And whoso loveth Me cometh to Me.
117:   Whoso shall offer Me in faith and love
118:   A leaf, a flower, a fruit, water poured forth,
119:   That offering I accept, lovingly made
120:   With pious will. Whate'er thou doest, Prince!
121:   Eating or sacrificing, giving gifts,
122:   Praying or fasting, let it all be done
123:   For Me, as Mine. So shalt thou free thyself
124:   From Karmabandh, the chain which holdeth men
125:   To good and evil issue, so shalt come
126:   Safe unto Me-when thou art quit of flesh--
127:   By faith and abdication joined to Me!
128: 
129:   I am alike for all! I know not hate,
130:   I know not favour! What is made is Mine!
131:   But them that worship Me with love, I love;
132:   They are in Me, and I in them!
133: 
134:   Nay, Prince!
135:   If one of evil life turn in his thought
136:   Straightly to Me, count him amidst the good;
137:   He hath the high way chosen; he shall grow
138:   Righteous ere long; he shall attain that peace
139:   Which changes not. Thou Prince of India!
140:   Be certain none can perish, trusting Me!
141:   O Pritha's Son! whoso will turn to Me,
142:   Though they be born from the very womb of Sin,
143:   Woman or man; sprung of the Vaisya caste
144:   Or lowly disregarded Sudra,--all
145:   Plant foot upon the highest path; how then
146:   The holy Brahmans and My Royal Saints?
147:   Ah! ye who into this ill world are come--
148:   Fleeting and false--set your faith fast on Me!
149:   Fix heart and thought on Me! Adore Me! Bring
150:   Offerings to Me! Make Me prostrations! Make
151:   Me your supremest joy! and, undivided,
152:   Unto My rest your spirits shall be guided.
153: 
154:   HERE ENDS CHAPTER IX. OF THE BHAGAVAD-GITA,
155:   Entitled "Rajavidyarajaguhyayog,"
156:   Or "The Book of Religion by the Kingly Knowledge and the Kingly
157:   Mystery."

paratext.text:
HERE ENDS CHAPTER IX. OF THE BHAGAVAD-GITA,
  Entitled "Rajavidyarajaguhyayog,"
  Or "The Book of Religion by the Kingly Knowledge and the Kingly
  Mystery."

records.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ॥
records.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
idaṃ tu te guhyatamaṃ pravakṣyāmyanasūyave
jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ yajjñātvā mokṣyase.aśubhāt
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Krishna.
  Now will I open unto thee--whose heart
  Rejects not--that last lore, deepest-concealed,
  That farthest secret of My Heavens and Earths,
  Which but to know shall set thee free from ills,--

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.1 The Blessed Lord said I shall now declare to thee who does not cavil, the greatest secret, the knowledge combined with experience (Self-realisation). Having known this thou shalt be free evil.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.1 "Lord Shri Krishna said: I will now reveal to thee, since thou doubtest not, that profound mysticism, which when followed by experience, shall liberate thee from sin.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.1 The Blessed Lord said However, to you who are not given to cavilling I shall speak of this highest secret itself, which is Knowledge [Jnana may mean Brahman that is Consciousness, or Its knowledge gathered from the Vedas (paroksa-jnana). Vijnana is direct experience (aparoksa-jnana).] combined with experience, by realizing which you shall be free from evil.

records.sanskrit:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम्।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम् ॥
records.iast:
rājavidyā rājaguhyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam
pratyakṣāvagamaṃ dharmyaṃ susukhaṃ kartumavyayam
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
A royal lore! a Kingly mystery!
  Yea! for the soul such light as purgeth it
  From every sin; a light of holiness
  With inmost splendour shining; plain to see;
  Easy to walk by, inexhaustible!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.2 This is the kingl science, the kingly secret, the supreme purifier, realisable by direct intuitional knowledge, according to righteousness, very easy to perform and imperishable.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.2 This is the Premier Science, the Sovereign Secret, the Purest and Best; intuitional, righteous; and to him who practiseth it pleasant beyond measure.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.2 This is the Sovereign Knowledge, the Sovereign Profundity, the best sanctifire; directly realizable, righteous, very easy to practise and imperishable.

records.sanskrit:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि ॥
records.iast:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa
aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
They that receive not this, failing in faith
  To grasp the greater wisdom, reach not Me,
  Destroyer of thy foes! They sink anew
  Into the realm of Flesh, where all things change!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.3 Those who have no faith in this Dharma (knowledge of the Self), O Parantapa (Arjuna), return to the path of this world of death without attaining Me.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.3 They who have no faith in this teaching cannot find Me, but remain lost in the purlieus of this perishable world.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.3 O destroyer of foes, persons who are regardless of this Dharma (knowledge of the Self) certainly go round and round, without reaching Me, along the path of transmigration which is fraught with death.

records.sanskrit:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः ॥
records.iast:
mayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā
matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
By Me the whole vast Universe of things
  Is spread abroad;--by Me, the Unmanifest!
  In Me are all existences contained;
  Not I in them!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.4 All this world is pervaded by Me in My unmanifest aspect; all beings exist in Me, but I do not dwell in them.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.4 The whole world is pervaded by Me, yet My form is not seen. All living things have their being in Me, yet I am not limited by them.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.4 This whole world is prevaded by Me in My unmanifest form. All beings exist in Me, but I am not contained in them!

records.sanskrit:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥
records.iast:
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram
bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Yet they are not contained,
  Those visible things! Receive and strive to embrace
  The mystery majestical! My Being--
  Creating all, sustaining all--still dwells
  Outside of all!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.5 Nor do beings exist in Me (in reality); behold My divine Yoga, supporting all beings, but not dwelling in them, is My Self, the efficient cause of beings.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.5 Nevertheless, they do not consciously abide in Me. Such is My Divine Sovereignty that though I, the Supreme Self, am the cause and upholder of all, yet I remain outside.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.5 Nor do the beings dwell in Me. Behod My divine Yoga! I am the sustainer and originator of beings, but My Self is not contained in the beings.

records.sanskrit:
यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय ॥
records.iast:
yathākāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni matsthānītyupadhāraya
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
See! as the shoreless airs
  Move in the measureless space, but are not space,
  [And space were space without the moving airs];
  So all things are in Me, but are not I.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.6 As the mighty wind, moving everywhere, rests always in the ether, even so, know thou that all beings rest in Me.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.6 As the mighty wind, though moving everywhere, has no resting place but space, so have all these beings no home but Me.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.6 Understand thus that just as the voluminous wind moving everywhere is ever present in space, similarly all beings abide in Me.

records.sanskrit:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम्।
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् ॥
records.iast:
sarvabhūtāni kaunteya prakṛtiṃ yānti māmikām
kalpakṣaye punastāni kalpādau visṛjāmyaham
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
At closing of each Kalpa, Indian Prince!
  All things which be back to My Being come:
  At the beginning of each Kalpa, all
  Issue new-born from Me.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.7 All beings, O Arjuna, go into My Nature at the end of a Kalpa; I send them forth again at the beginning of (the next) Kalpa.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.7 All beings, O Arjuna, return at the close of every cosmic cycle into the realm of Nature, which is a part of Me, and at the beginning of the next I send them forth again.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.7 O son Kunti, all the beings go back at the end of a cycle to My Prakrti. I project them forth again at the beginning of a cycle.

records.sanskrit:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः।
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ॥
records.iast:
prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi punaḥ punaḥ
bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kṛtsnamavaśaṃ prakṛtervaśāt
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
By Energy
  And help of Prakriti my outer Self,
  Again, and yet again, I make go forth
  The realms of visible things--without their will--
  All of them--by the power of Prakriti.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.8 Animating My Nature, I again and again send forth all this multitude of beings, helpless by the force of the Nature.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.8 With the help of Nature, again and again I pour forth the whole multitude of beings, whether they will or no, for they are ruled by My Will.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.8 Keeping My own prakrti under control, I project forth again and again the whole of this multitude of beings which are powerless owing to the influence of (their own) nature.

records.sanskrit:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय।
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु ॥
records.iast:
na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
udāsīnavadāsīnamasaktaṃ teṣu karmasu
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Yet these great makings, Prince! involve Me not
  Enchain Me not! I sit apart from them,
  Other, and Higher, and Free; nowise attached!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.9 These acts do not bind Me, O Arjuna, sitting like one indifferent, unattached to those acts.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.9 But these acts of mine do not bind Me. I remain outside and unattached.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.9 O Dhananjaya (Arjuna), nor do those actions bind Me, remaining (as I do) like one unconcerned with, and unattached to, those actions.

records.sanskrit:
मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम्।
हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते ॥
records.iast:
mayādhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ sūyate sacarācaram
hetunānena kaunteya jagadviparivartate
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Thus doth the stuff of worlds, moulded by Me,
  Bring forth all that which is, moving or still,
  Living or lifeless! Thus the worlds go on!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.10 Under Me as supervisor, Nature produces the moving and the unmoving; because of this, O Arjuna, the world revolves.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.10 Under my guidance, Nature produces all things movable and immovable. Thus it is, O Arjuna, that this universe revolves.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.10 Under Me as the supervisor, the Prakrti produces (the world) of the moving and the non-moving things. Owing to this reason, O son of Kunti, the world revolves.

records.sanskrit:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम्।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥
records.iast:
avajānanti māṃ mūḍhā mānuṣīṃ tanumāśritam
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mama bhūtamaheśvaram
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
The minds untaught mistake Me, veiled in form;--
  Naught see they of My secret Presence, nought
  Of My hid Nature, ruling all which lives.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.11 Fools disregard Me, clad in human form, not knowing My higher Being as the great Lord of (all) beings.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.11 Fools disregard Me, seeing Me clad in human form. They know not that in My higher nature I am the Lord-God of all.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.11 Not knowing My supreme nature as the Lord of all beings, foolish people disregard Me who have taken a human body.

records.sanskrit:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः।
राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥
records.iast:
moghāśā moghakarmāṇo moghajñānā vicetasaḥ
rākṣasīmāsurīṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ mohinīṃ śritāḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Vain hopes pursuing, vain deeds doing; fed
  On vainest knowledge, senselessly they seek
  An evil way, the way of brutes and fiends.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.12 Of vain hopes, of vain actions, of vain knowledge and senseless, they verily are possessed of the deceitful nature of demons and undivine beings.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.12 Their hopes are vain, their actions worthless, their knowledge futile; they are without sense, deceitful, barbarous and godless.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.12 Of vain hopes, of vain actions, of vain knowledge, and senseless, they become verily possessed of the deceptive disposition of fiends and demons.

records.sanskrit:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ॥
records.iast:
mahātmānastu māṃ pārtha daivīṃ prakṛtimāśritāḥ
bhajantyananyamanaso jñātvā bhūtādimavyayam
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
But My Mahatmas, those of noble soul
  Who tread the path celestial, worship Me
  With hearts unwandering,--knowing Me the Source,
  Th' Eternal Source, of Life.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.13 But the great souls, O Arjuna, partaking of My divine nature, worship Me with a single mind (with the mind devoted to nothing else), knowing Me as the imperishable source of beings.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.13 But the Great Souls, O Arjuna! Filled with My Divine Spirit, they worship Me, they fix their minds on Me and on Me alone, for they know that I am the imperishable Source of being.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.13 O son of Prtha, the noble ones, being possessed of divine nature, surely adore Me with single-mindedness, knowing Me as the immutable source of all objects.

records.sanskrit:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥
records.iast:
satataṃ kīrtayanto māṃ yatantaśca dṛḍhavratāḥ
namasyantaśca māṃ bhaktyā nityayuktā upāsate
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Unendingly
  They glorify Me; seek Me; keep their vows
  Of reverence and love, with changeless faith
  Adoring Me.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.14 Always glorifying Me, striving,firm in vows, prostrating themselves before Me, they worship Me with devotion always steadfast.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.14 Always extolling Me, strenuous, firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before Me, they worship Me continually with concentrated devotion.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.14 Always glorifying Me and striving, the men of firm vows worship Me by paying obeisance to Me and being ever endowed with devotion.

records.sanskrit:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
records.iast:
jñānayajñena cāpyanye yajanto māmupāsate
ekatvena pṛthaktvena bahudhā viśvatomukham
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Yea, and those too adore,
  Who, offering sacrifice of wakened hearts,
  Have sense of one pervading Spirit's stress,
  One Force in every place, though manifold!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.15 Others also sacrificing with the wisdom-sacrifice worship Me, the All-faced, as one, as distinct, and as manifold.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.15 Others worship Me with full consciousness as the One, the Manifold, the Omnipresent, the Universal.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.15 Others verily worship Me by adoring exclusively through the sacrifice of the knowledge of oneness; (others worship Me) multifariously, and (others) as the multiformed existing variously.

records.sanskrit:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम्।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ॥
records.iast:
ahaṃ kraturahaṃ yajñaḥ svadhāhamahamauṣadham
mantro.ahamahamevājyamahamagnirahaṃ hutam
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
I am the Sacrifice! I am the Prayer!
  I am the Funeral-Cake set for the dead!
  I am the healing herb! I am the ghee,
  The Mantra, and the flame, and that which burns!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.16 I am the Kratu; I am the Yajna; I am the offering (food) to the manes; I am the medicinal herbs and all the plants; I am the Mantra; I am also the Ghee or the melted butter; I am the fire; I am the oblation.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.16 I am the Oblation, the Sacrifice and the Worship; I am the Fuel and the Chant, I am the Butter offered to the fire, I am the Fire itself, and I am the Act of offering.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.16 I am the kratu, I am the yajna, I am the svadha, I am the ausadha, I am the mantra, I Myself am the ajya, I am the fire, and I am the act of offering.

records.sanskrit:
पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च ॥
records.iast:
pitāhamasya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ
vedyaṃ pavitramoṃkāra ṛksāma yajureva ca
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
I am-of all this boundless Universe-
  The Father, Mother, Ancestor, and Guard!
  The end of Learning! That which purifies
  In lustral water! I am OM! I am
  Rig-Veda, Sama-Veda, Yajur-Ved;

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text:
9.17 I am the father of this world, the mother, the dispenser of the fruits of actions and the
grandfather; the (one) thing to be known, the purifier, the sacred monosyllable (Om), and also the Rik-, the Sama-and the Yajur-Vedas.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.17 I am the Father of the universe and its Mother; I am its Nourisher and its Grandfather; I am the Knowable and the Pure; I am Om; and I am the Sacred Scriptures.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.17 Of this world I am the father, mother, ordainer, (and the), grand-father; I am the knowable, the sancitifier, the syllable Om as also Rk, Sama and Yajus.

records.sanskrit:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्।
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥
records.iast:
gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
The Way, the Fosterer, the Lord, the Judge,
  The Witness; the Abode, the Refuge-House,
  The Friend, the Fountain and the Sea of Life
  Which sends, and swallows up; Treasure of Worlds
  And Treasure-Chamber! Seed and Seed-Sower,
  Whence endless harvests spring!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.18 I am the goal, the supporter, the Lord, the witness, the abode, the shelter, the friend, the origin, the dissolution, the foundation, the treasure-house and the seed which is imperishable.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.18 I am the Goal, the Sustainer, the Lord, the Witness, the Home, the Shelter, the Lover and the Origin; I am Life and Death; I am the Fountain and the Seed Imperishable.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.18 (I am) the fruit of actions, the nourisher, the Lord, witness, abode, refuge, friend, origin, end, foundation, store and the imperishable seed.

records.sanskrit:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च।
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन ॥
records.iast:
tapāmyahamahaṃ varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmyutsṛjāmi ca
amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca sadasaccāhamarjuna
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.19 (As the sun) I give heat; I withhold and send forth the rain; I am immortality and also death, existence and non-existence, O Arjuna.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.19 I am the Heat of the Sun, I release and hold back the Rains. I am Death and Immortality; I am Being and Not-Being.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.19 O Arjuna, I give heat, I withhold and pour down rain. I am verily the nectar, and also death existence and nonexistence.

records.sanskrit:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा
यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक-
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् ॥
records.iast:
traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante
te puṇyamāsādya surendralokaṃ aśnanti divyāndivi devabhogān
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Yea! those who learn
    The threefold Veds, who drink the Soma-wine,
  Purge sins, pay sacrifice--from Me they earn
    Passage to Swarga; where the meats divine

  Of great gods feed them in high Indra's heaven.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.20 The knowers of the three Vedas, the drinkers of Soma, purified of all sins, worshipping Me by sacrifices, pray for the way to heaven; they reach the holy world of the Lord of the gods and enjoy in heavn the divine pleasures of the gods.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.20 Those who are versed in the scriptures, who drink the mystic Soma-juice and are purified from sin, but who while worshipping Me with sacrifices pray that I will lead them to heaven; they reach the holy world where lives the Controller of the Powers of Nature, and they enjoy the feasts of Paradise.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.20 Those who are versed in the Vedas, who are drinkers of Soma and are purified of sin, pray for the heavenly goal by worshipping Me through sacrifices. Having reached the place (world) of the king of gods, which is the result of righteousness, they enjoy in heaven th divine pleasure of gods.

records.sanskrit:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥
records.iast:
te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti
evaṃ trayīdharmamanuprapannā gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Yet they, when that prodigious joy is o'er,
  Paradise spent, and wage for merits given,
    Come to the world of death and change once more.

  They had their recompense! they stored their treasure,
    Following the threefold Scripture and its writ;
  Who seeketh such gaineth the fleeting pleasure
    Of joy which comes and goes! I grant them it!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.21 They, having enjoyed the vast heaven, enter the world of mortals when their merit is exhausted; thus abiding by the injunctions of the ï1threeï1 (Vedas) and desiring (objects of) desires, they attain to the state of going and returning.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.21 Yet although they enjoy the spacious glories of Paradise, nevertheless, when their merit is exhausted, they are born again into this world of mortals. They have followed the letter of the scriptures, yet because they have sought but to fulfill their own desires, they must depart and return again and again.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.21 After having enjoyed that vast heavenly world, they enter into the human world on the exhaustion of their merit. Thus, those who follow the rites and duties prescribed in the three Vedas, and are desirous of pleasures, attain the state of going and returning.

records.sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥
records.iast:
ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate
teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
But to those blessed ones who worship Me,
  Turning not otherwhere, with minds set fast,
  I bring assurance of full bliss beyond.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.22 For those men who worship Me alone, thinking of no other, for those ever-united, I secure what is not already possessed and preserve what they already possess.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.22 But if a man will meditate on Me and Me alone, and will worship Me always and everywhere, I will take upon Myself the fulfillment of his aspiration, and I will safeguard whatsoever he shall attain.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.22 Those persons who, becoming non-different from Me and meditative, worship Me everywhere, for them, who are ever attached (to Me), I arrange for securing what they lack and preserving what they have.

records.sanskrit:
येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः।
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम् ॥
records.iast:
ye.apyanyadevatābhaktā yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ
te.api māmeva kaunteya yajantyavidhipūrvakam
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.23 Even those devotees who, endowed with faith, worship other gods, worship Me alone, O Arjuna, b the wrong method.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.23 Even those who worship the lesser Powers, if they do so with faith, they thereby worship Me, though not in the right way.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.23 Even those who, being devoted to other deities and endowed with faith, worship (them), they also, O son of Kunti, worship Me alone (though) following the wrong method.

records.sanskrit:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च।
न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते ॥
records.iast:
ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca
na tu māmabhijānanti tattvenātaścyavanti te
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
For I am the Receiver and the Lord
  Of every sacrifice, which these know not
  Rightfully; so they fall to earth again!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.24 (For) I alone am the enjoyer and also the Lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in essence (in reality), and hence they fall (return to this mortal world).

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.24 I am the willing recipient of sacrifice, and I am its true Lord. But these do not know me in truth, and so they sink back.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.24 I indeed am the enjoyer as also the Lord of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in reality. Therefore they fall.

records.sanskrit:
यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितॄन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः।
भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम् ॥
records.iast:
yānti devavratā devānpitṝnyānti pitṛvratāḥ
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino.api mām
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Who follow gods go to their gods; who vow
  Their souls to Pitris go to Pitris; minds
  To evil Bhuts given o'er sink to the Bhuts;
  And whoso loveth Me cometh to Me.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.25 The worshippers of the gods go to them; to the manes go the ancestor-worshippers; to the deities who preside over the elements go their worshippers; but My devotees come to Me.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.25 The votaries of the lesser Powers go to them; the devotees of spirits go to them; they who worship the Powers of Darkness, to such Powers shall they go; and so, too, those who worship Me shall come to Me.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.25 Votaries of the gods reach the gods; the votarites of the manes go to the manes; the worshippers of the Beings reach the Beings; and those who worship Me reach Me.

records.sanskrit:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥
records.iast:
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati
tadahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Whoso shall offer Me in faith and love
  A leaf, a flower, a fruit, water poured forth,
  That offering I accept, lovingly made
  With pious will.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.26 Whoever offers Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit or a little water that, so offered devotedly by the pure-minded, I accept.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.26 Whatever a man offers to Me, whether it be a leaf, or a flower, or fruit, or water, I accept it, for it is offered with devotion and purity of mind.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.26 Whoever offers Me with devotion-a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water, I accept that (gift) of the pure-hearted man which has been devotionally presented.

records.sanskrit:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्।
यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥
records.iast:
yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat
yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Whate'er thou doest, Prince!
  Eating or sacrificing, giving gifts,
  Praying or fasting, let it all be done
  For Me, as Mine.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.27 Whatever thou doest, whatever thou eatest, whatever thou offerest in sacrifice, whatever thou givest, whatever thou practisest as austerity, O Arjuna, do it as an offering unto Me.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.27 Whatever thou doest, whatever thou dost eat, whatever thou dost sacrifice and give, whatever austerities thou practisest, do all as an offering to Me.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.27 O son of Kunti, whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer as a sacrifice, whatever you give and whatever austerities you undertake, (all) that you offer to Me.

records.sanskrit:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः।
संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि ॥
records.iast:
śubhāśubhaphalairevaṃ mokṣyase karmabandhanaiḥ
saṃnyāsayogayuktātmā vimukto māmupaiṣyasi
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
So shalt thou free thyself
  From Karmabandh, the chain which holdeth men
  To good and evil issue, so shalt come
  Safe unto Me-when thou art quit of flesh--
  By faith and abdication joined to Me!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.28 Thus shalt thou be freed from the bonds of actions yielding good and evil fruits; with the mind steadfast in the Yoga of renunciation, and liberated, thou shalt come unto Me.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.28 So shall thy action be attended by no result, either good or bad; but through the spirit of renunciation thou shalt come to Me and be free.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.28 Thus, you will become free from bondage in the form of actions which are productive of good and bad results. Havng your mind inbued with the yoga of renunciation and becoming free, you will attain Me.

records.sanskrit:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥
records.iast:
samo.ahaṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo.asti na priyaḥ
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
I am alike for all! I know not hate,
  I know not favour! What is made is Mine!
  But them that worship Me with love, I love;
  They are in Me, and I in them!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.29 The same am I to all beings; to Me there is none hateful or dear; but those who worship Me with devotion are in Me and I am also in them.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.29 I am the same to all beings. I favour none, and I hate none. But those who worship Me devotedly, they live in Me, and I in them.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.29 I am impartial towards all beings; to Me there is none detastable or none dear. But those who worship Me with devotion, they exist in Me, and I too exist in them.

records.sanskrit:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्।
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ॥
records.iast:
api cetsudurācāro bhajate māmananyabhāk
sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.30 Even if the most sinful worships Me, with devotion to none else, he too should indeed by regarded as righteous for he has rightly resolved.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.30 Even the most sinful, if he worship Me with his whole heart, shalt be considered righteous, for he is treading the right path.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.30 Even if a man of very bad conduct worships Me with one-pointed devotion, he is to be considered verily good; for he has resolved rightly.

records.sanskrit:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति।
कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥
records.iast:
kṣipraṃ bhavati dharmātmā śaśvacchāntiṃ nigacchati
kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
he shall grow
  Righteous ere long; he shall attain that peace
  Which changes not. Thou Prince of India!
  Be certain none can perish, trusting Me!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.31 Soon he becomes righteous and attains to eternal peace; O Arjuna, proclaim thou for certain that My devotee never perishes.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.31 He shall attain spirituality ere long, and Eternal Peace shall be his. O Arjuna! Believe me, My devotee is never lost.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.31 He soon becomes possessed of a virtuous mind; he attains everlasting peace. Do you proclain boldly, O son of Kunti, that My devotee does not get ruined.

records.sanskrit:
मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
records.iast:
māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye.api syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste.api yānti parāṃ gatim
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
O Pritha's Son! whoso will turn to Me,
  Though they be born from the very womb of Sin,
  Woman or man; sprung of the Vaisya caste
  Or lowly disregarded Sudra,--all
  Plant foot upon the highest path;

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.32 For, taking refuge in Me, they also who, O Arjuna, may be of a sinful birth women, Vaisyas as well as Sudras attain the Supreme Goal.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.32 For even the children of sinful parents, and those miscalled the weaker sex, and merchants, and labourers, if only they will make Me their refuge, they shall attain the Highest.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.32 For, O son of Prtha, even those who are born of sin-women, Vaisyas, as also Sudras [S.'s construction of this portion is: women, Vaisyas as also Sudras, and even others who are born of sin (i.e., those who are born low and are of vile deeds, viz Mlecchas, Pukkasas and others). M.S. also takes papa-yonayah (born of sin) as a separate phrase, and classifies women and others only as those darred from Vedic study, etc.-Tr.]-, even they reach the highest Goal by taking shelter under Me.

records.sanskrit:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा।
अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम् ॥
records.iast:
kiṃ punarbrāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣayastathā
anityamasukhaṃ lokamimaṃ prāpya bhajasva mām
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
how then
  The holy Brahmans and My Royal Saints?
  Ah! ye who into this ill world are come--
  Fleeting and false--set your faith fast on Me!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.33 How much more (easily) then the hold Brahmins and devoted royal saints (attain the goal); having come to this impermanent and unhappy world, do thou worship Me.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.33 What need then to mention the holy Ministers of God, the devotees and the saintly rulers? Do thou, therefore, born in this changing and miserable world, do thou too worship Me.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.33 What to speak of the holy Brahmanas as also of devout kind-sages! Having come to this ephemeral and miserable world, do you worship Me.

records.sanskrit:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।
मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः ॥
records.iast:
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru
māmevaiṣyasi yuktvaivamātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Fix heart and thought on Me! Adore Me! Bring
  Offerings to Me! Make Me prostrations! Make
  Me your supremest joy! and, undivided,
  Unto My rest your spirits shall be guided.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 9.34 Fix thy mind on Me; by devoted to Me; sacrifice unto Me; bow down to Me; having thus united thy whole self to Me, taking Me as the supreme goal, thou shalt come unto Me.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 9.34 Fix thy mind on Me, devote thyself to Me, sacrifice for Me, surrender to Me, make Me the object of thy aspirations, and thou shalt assuredly become one with Me, Who am thine own Self."

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 9.34 Having your mind fixed on Me, be devoted to Me, sacrifice to Me, and bow down to Me. By concentrating your mind and accepting Me as the supreme Goal, you shall surely attain Me who am thus the Self.
